book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page1:
Betel Skyblock Guide

Classic: check the chest.
One block: compress 18 residue into 2 blocks for footholds. The central block does not regenerate.
Protect your saplings, soil and water before expanding.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page2:
Planting and tools

Plant betel saplings on dirt in good light. They grow naturally in skyblock; bone meal speeds this up.
Use wood for tools, a composter and platforms. Save sapling materials before felling trees.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page3:
Harvest and replant

Shears: right-click a bunch.
Green: 3 raw nuts.
Yellow: 5 raw nuts, or craft with a leaf for a sapling.
Keep the rooted trunk and crown for new fruit. Leaves drop betel leaves.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page4:
Manual composting

In either skyblock, use raw nuts (65%), betel leaves or leaf blocks (30%) on a composter. The first layer always works.
At 7 layers, wait, then use an empty hand for bone meal. These extra inputs are manual only.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page5:
Water, stone, food

Break 2 ice blocks in a solid-bottom basin for infinite water.
Water and lava make cobblestone. Keep water off the lava source.
Grow wheat and cane by water. Eat bread as a staple.

book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page6:
Renewable materials

Bone meal on moss spreads over stone and grows azaleas. Azalea trees make rooted dirt below; mine it or hoe it into dirt.
Grow oak by flowers for a bee nest chance. Grow cocoa on jungle logs.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page7:
Processing and health

Roast nuts on a campfire or in a furnace. Farmer's Delight cookware makes variants.
Betel raises addiction and oral risks. Medicine and golden paste are finite reserves. Oral cancer II allows soft food and betel; stage III or a locked jaw blocks betel.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page8:
Later progression

Keep budding amethyst in place, with clear sides. Harvest mature clusters.
Farm mobs for iron and redstone; cure zombie villagers to trade. Nether quartz, gold and blaze rods help make Synthetic World betel.
book.betel_nut_mod.skyblock_guide.page9:
End and rescue

In water: 16 Eyes of Ender + 12 Synthetic World betel give 12 portal frames by default. Keep 12 more eyes to activate correctly facing frames.
Void rescue finds safe ground or adds one bedrock foothold.
